# teams_personal_attendant_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing PersonalAttendantPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_recording` (String) Maps to the -AutomaticRecording parameter.
- `automatic_transcription` (String) Maps to the -AutomaticTranscription parameter.
- `calendar_bookings` (String) Maps to the -CalendarBookings parameter.
- `call_screening` (String) Maps to the -CallScreening parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `inbound_federated_calls` (String) Maps to the -InboundFederatedCalls parameter.
- `inbound_internal_calls` (String) Maps to the -InboundInternalCalls parameter.
- `inbound_pstn_calls` (String) Maps to the -InboundPSTNCalls parameter.
- `personal_attendant` (String) Maps to the -PersonalAttendant parameter.
